semiconductor_relevance: High — Yamazen provides specialized equipment and solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including optical and electron microscopes, FIB-SEMs, and automated guided vehicles.
summary: Yamazen is focused on supporting the semiconductor industry by offering a range of cost-effective equipment and solutions. Their product lineup includes advanced optical microscopes capable of submicron observation, high-performance FIB-SEMs, and automated guided vehicles designed for efficient transport within semiconductor fabs.
capabilities: FIB-SEMs with high performance at low cost
Automated guided vehicles for wafer transport

regional_presence.Japan: This is Yamazen's first time exhibiting at SEMICON Japan, indicating a strategic focus on the Japanese semiconductor market.
